thread:
Maya Patel: Planning a Dedicated rollout for BlueHorizon Labs tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Patch v2.4.1 -> includes runtime bugfix + KMS client patch. Need approvals for: version pin, KMS rotation hold, canary plan, rollback TTL. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.4.1 :link:

deploy-bot: preflight checks started for release 2.4.1 on tenant bluehorizon...
deploy-bot: preflight result: build ok, infra checks ok, KMS rotation detected in tenant schedule (overlaps window). flagged KMS-bot for review.

Sanjay Kumar: KMS overlap is the kicker. If KMS rotates mid-deploy we could hit key-not-found errors for cached tokens. Can we freeze rotation for that tenant only?

KMS-bot: Detected scheduled KMS rotation for bluehorizon at 02:10 UTC. Suggested actions: postpone rotation to 04:00 UTC or enable dual-key fallback.

Elaine Wu: +1 to postponing rotation. Dual-key fallback is riskier and needs testing. I'd prefer freeze rotation only for the BlueHorizon KMS calendar.

Maya Patel: Proposed plan:
- Start canary at 02:15 UTC (5% of traffic, slice-7)
- Pin runtime to 2.4.1 for the tenant for the duration of the window
- Pause any scheduled KMS rotations on bluehorizon until 04:00 UTC
- If errors spike >3% or latency +200ms for 10m -> automatic rollback to 2.3.9
- Rollback TTL: 30m (manual confirm after auto-rollback)
- Operators: ops-oncall will watch metrics and be primary for rollback

Command we'll run:
```
deployctl rollout --env dedicated --tenant bluehorizon --version 2.4.1 --canary 5 --slice slice-7 --pause-after 15m
```

Sanjay Kumar: One more ask: add an extra healthcheck that verifies KMS key lookup path at canary. If key lookup fails, don't promote.

Maya Patel: Good call. We'll add `kms-lookup` to the canary healthchecks.

ops-oncall: I can be on pager from 01:45-03:30 UTC. I'll create a short dashboard: latency, error-rate, KMS-lookup-failures, token-errors. Ping me if anything unusual.

deploy-bot: schedule request validated. Conflicts cleared except KMS rotation (pending).

Elaine Wu: Approve from infra side :white_check_mark:

Sanjay Kumar: Approve from runtime side :+1:

Maya Patel: Ops approve?

ops-oncall: Ack, I'm monitoring and will escalate if needed. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: 2026-03-21T02:15:00Z -> tenant bluehorizon -> version 2.4.1 -> canary 5% -> operator ops-oncall

deploy-bot: NOTE: KMS rotation remains scheduled at 02:10 UTC for bluehorizon. Please run `kmsctl postpone --tenant bluehorizon --until 2026-03-21T04:00:00Z` to avoid collision.

Maya Patel: I've asked infra to postpone rotation; will update here once confirmed. Also saving release notes and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bluehorizon-2.4.1

KMS-bot: Rotation postponed by infra: new time 2026-03-21T04:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: Final approvals locked. Proceeding with scheduled rollout. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: thread closed (scheduled). Logs will be posted in this thread during canary and after full promotion.
